title: 电解电容负极朝向标记后再焊接
titleEn: Orient the electrolytic capacitor to its minus mark, then solder
prompt: 顺序：cap 在 solder 之前。cap 朝向必须是 minus-marked（负极/色条对着板上的标记）。不要先焊再转方向。
promptEn: Order: cap before solder. The cap orientation must be minus-marked (the minus stripe faces the mark on the board). Do not solder it before setting the orientation.

title: JST 插头按键位插好后再上电
titleEn: Seat the keyed JST connector before applying power
prompt: 顺序：jst-plug 在 power 之前。jst-plug 朝向必须是 keyed。不要先通电再插插头。
promptEn: Order: jst-plug before power. The jst-plug orientation must be keyed. Do not apply power before the connector is seated.
